name: container-registry
description: Private Docker container registry for storing and managing container images. Required when using Container Apps with docker remoteBuild.

bicep.note: Container Registry is typically created alongside Container Apps Environment in the same module

roleAssignments.note: Backend managed identity needs pull access to registry
Deploying user needs push access during azd deploy

notes: Usually bundled with container-apps module rather than deployed standalone
Required when azure.yaml service has docker.remoteBuild: true
The container-apps.bicep module creates both the environment AND the registry

integration.authNote: Container Apps pull images using managed identity (AcrPull role). The deploying user pushes with AcrPush. Admin user can be disabled once identity-based pull is configured.

bicepWiring.note: adminUserEnabled: true is needed for azd deploy remoteBuild. Once CI/CD uses service principal, can disable admin.
